newsitem.title: THAILAND: Suspended Maha Thanakit to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Suspended Maha Thanakit to raise capital.

text.p: Maha Thanakit Finance and Securities Plc said on Monday it had obtained approval from shareholders to raise its capital to 5.5 billion baht ($177 million) from 500 million.

Maha Thanakit, one of 42 finance and brokerage firms suspended by the authorities since August 5, said 3.5 billion baht of the additional capital would be raised through a 7-for-1 rights issue of 350 million new shares at 10 baht each.

It said in a statement that 2.15 billion baht of funds obtained from the rights issue would be used for repaying loans borrowed from the Financial Institutions Development Fund, a unit in the central bank.
The remaining proceeds would be set aside for meeting any future withdrawals by depositors.
The company said the rights issue would be offered from September 1-5 with payment due within 30 days after it is permitted to resume business.
